newHint: The crew slots are created from the competition (VAR, observer).
rescheduledWarn: Fixture moved: {n} officials no longer meet the conditions, check the board.

hints.importance: 0 to 100: weighs on who is chosen.
hints.reason: Officials already designated are told, with this reason.
hints.reasonNotified: Required: designated officials are told, with this reason.

errors.score: A score from 0 to 99 for each team.
errors.duplicate: These teams already meet on this matchday.
errors.invalid_local_time: That time does not exist on that day (clock change).
errors.team_outside_country: A domestic fixture is between teams of the competition's country.
errors.stadium_outside_country: The stadium must be in the competition's country.
errors.not_yet_played: The match has not been played yet.
errors.no_referee: A designated referee is needed to record the result.
errors.duplicate_match: A match between these teams is already recorded on that day.
errors.not_validated: The crew must be validated first.
errors.not_published: The convocations are not published yet.
errors.unknown: That team, stadium or competition no longer exists: reload the page.

blocked.incomplete: Every required role needs an official before the crew goes out for confirmation.
blocked.unconfirmed: Every official must have confirmed before validation.

done.submit: Crew sent to the officials for confirmation.
done.publish: Convocations published: every official has been told.

body.postponed: The fixture leaves the active calendar; the crew is kept.
body.cancelled: The fixture is cancelled; designated officials are told.
body.scheduled: The fixture returns to the calendar. Then check its date and crew.

result.title: Result
result.hint: The match can then be assessed and billed; it can no longer be changed.
